tasksTab.whyQueuedTitle: Why can a task stay queued?
tasksTab.whyQueuedIntro: The queue does auto-fill freed slots, but “max concurrent tasks” is an upper bound, not a guarantee that all tasks can start immediately.
tasksTab.reasonConcurrency: A task can only continue when a concurrency slot becomes free.
tasksTab.reasonGpuVram: Even with a free slot, the scheduler still needs an available GPU and enough free VRAM.
tasksTab.reasonSharedQueue: Training jobs, inference jobs, and AI Chat Page PDF high-quality GPU parsing all share the same GPU queue.
tasksTab.reasonCancellation: Cancelled tasks release resources asynchronously; once resources are actually released, later tasks are retried automatically.
tasksTab.reasonRecovery: After a restart or power loss, queued training tasks that were persisted in the database are automatically re-queued; transient AI Chat Page PDF parsing jobs are not persisted and must be retriggered by a new request.

s4.title: 4. Data sources and your responsibilities
items: 4.1 We may receive personal data from you directly, from your organization or administrator, from your device or browser, or from integrations and service providers used to operate the Services.
4.2 You are responsible for ensuring that any patient, research, employee, or third-party data you upload, connect, or submit is lawfully collected, lawfully shared, and de-identified where required.

4.3 Browser storage and PWA caches may retain session information, preferences, drafts, and application resources. Deleting a local copy does not delete server records. Sign out and manage stored site data on shared devices.

4.4 Username, password, and the educational email requested in the access-request form are required for that application; without them we cannot process it. Nickname and optional feature inputs are voluntary. Declining microphone permission or an optional AI feature prevents that feature from working, rather than authorizing collection by another route.

s5.title: 5. Disclosure, processors, and cross-border handling
items: 5.1 When enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile or Tencent CAPTCHA receives network, browser, and verification data. The server may query ip-api.com with an IP address to select regional verification or registration handling. Configured AI, speech, search, document-processing, hosting, and connector providers may receive inputs needed for the requested function. Opening these legal notices does not itself trigger an external IP lookup.

5.2 Authorized administrators or institutional personnel may access relevant records where necessary for account administration, security response, auditing, permissions management, or legal compliance.

5.3 External processing may occur outside Hong Kong. Ask the deployment administrator or our contact for the configured recipients, locations, retention, and training-use terms before submitting sensitive data. Local installation alone does not prevent those transfers.

5.4 Where we engage processors, we must use contractual or other means required by DPP2(3) and DPP4(2) to address retention and security, including overseas processing. A provider's own terms do not replace our duties. The PCPD's <pcpdTransfers>recommended model contractual clauses</pcpdTransfers> provide guidance for cross-border arrangements.

5.5 Lawful disclosures may also be made to advisers, courts, or authorities where necessary for legal obligations or claims. This is not a general permission to publish personal data or share it with unrelated recipients.

s6.title: 6. Retention and security
items: 6.1 Under DPP2 and section 26 of Cap. 486, we must take all practicable steps to keep data accurate and erase personal data no longer required, unless erasure is prohibited by law or retention is in the public interest. Account administration, active research, security incidents, and legal claims may require different periods; they do not justify indefinite retention.

6.2 Deleting a conversation removes it from the list while related cleanup runs in the background. Files kept independently in the file library or only referenced by that conversation remain. Backups and copies held by providers require separate retention and deletion handling. Request deletion or the applicable retention details through the contact below; this notice does not promise immediate erasure of all copies.

6.3 We must take all practicable steps required by DPP4 to protect data against unauthorized or accidental access, processing, erasure, loss, or use. No system is completely secure. A security incident must be assessed and contained, with notifications to affected people and authorities where applicable law requires or the assessed risk warrants them.

s7.title: 7. Access, correction, and contact
items: 7.1 You may request access to and correction of personal data under DPP6 and Part 5 of <lawCap486>Cap. 486</lawCap486>. Sections 19 and 23 generally require compliance within 40 days of receipt, subject to statutory exceptions and notification requirements. Any access fee must not be excessive under section 28; data correction is not charged.

7.2 Send requests to the contact shown at the top of this notice, identifying the account and data concerned. We may ask for proportionate information to verify identity and authority. For an institutional deployment, contact its administrator or data-protection contact; we can help identify the appropriate recipient.

7.3 You may ask for deletion of data no longer required, raise a concern about processing, or withdraw prescribed consent for a new purpose by written notice. These requests remain subject to applicable law and justified retention. You may also complain to the <pcpdContact>Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data</pcpdContact>; using our contact channel is not a prerequisite.

s8.title: 8. Changes to this notice
items: 8.1 We may update this Privacy Notice and Privacy Policy from time to time for legal, operational, security, or product reasons.

8.2 Material changes will be brought to your attention through the product or another appropriate channel. Notice of a change does not itself supply prescribed consent for a new purpose. Statutory rights and necessary consents continue to apply.
